summary: Prepare the signed pooled-tenancy schema contract to recognize the exact future Cloud passkey ledger without applying its migration.
userImpact: The existing application behavior remains unchanged while staging gains a safe rollback target for a later passkey migration.

instructions: Deploy this compatibility release and retire older pooled-tenancy binaries before an owner job applies migration 0133.

configuration: No new configuration is required; application startup remains verify-only and owner migration remains bounded to the existing 0131 transition.

notes: This release must not execute migration 0133 or create passkey tables; it only recognizes the exact future ledger and unchanged explicit-context RLS profile.

security: The signed candidate, image, and host chart bind the exact future migration identity and ledger hash; any other ledger still fails closed.
knownLimitations: Passkey sign-up stays disabled until the subsequent owner-controlled migration and feature release.
rollback: Before migration 0133, redeploy the prior release. After migration 0133, retain this compatibility release as the application rollback target.
validation: Focused schema-epoch parser and ledger tests, candidate-receipt contract tests, host-chart render checks, PostgreSQL owner/preflight integration, and protected Cloud intake contract checks.
